Sofia, I've posted the draft bullets for June as a reply to your message in #coastal-team. I haven't sent them to anyone.

- **Rename:** Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb. Kwame's 17 Feb message in the channel says the same.
- **Shared label:** "PHL" now matches both Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so a "PHL" filter returns rows for both.
- **Old report name:** Moss's 18 May coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It says this made the receiving supervisor search twice.
- **Open question:** You said on 17 Feb that you'd relabel the saved retail view. I can't tell whether that happened, because Moss's digest is five months old. The draft flags it as a check, so confirm the current state before it goes out.
- **Ask for June:** The draft asks her to confirm the label is updated and that views spell the name out instead of using "PHL".

Tell me what to change. I can also send it to June as a DM or mail if you want.
